description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides mechanisms for shared, process-wide cyclic buffer management, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration functionalities. It includes nested classes, methods for buffer operations, and synchronization primitives, indicating its role in inter-process data sharing and buffer control.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class facilitating shared cyclic buffer management across process boundaries, with methods for locking, unlocking, reading, writing, and buffer administration.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A nested helper class within CyclicBuffer for peeking and managing read positions within the buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(const string& fileName, const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with a filename, mode, size, and overwrite policy.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(Core::DataElementFile& buffer, const bool initiator, const uint32_t offset, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with an existing data element file, offset, size, and overwrite policy.

methods.name: uint32_t Lock(bool dataPresent = false, const uint32_t waitTime = Core::infinite)
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: uint32_t Unlock()
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: uint32_t Read(uint8_t buffer[], const uint32_t length, bool partialRead = false)
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer, destructive operation that advances the tail.

methods.name: uint32_t Write(const uint8_t buffer[], const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, advancing the head.

methods.name: uint32_t Reserve(const uint32_t length)
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for upcoming write operations.

methods.name: void DataAvailable()
methods.description: Notifies that data is available in the buffer.
